name: Omakase☆Demakase Angel!! ~Chocolat to Milfy Shukufuku Shichau zo~
original_name: おまかせ☆でまかせ え～んじぇる!! ～ショコラとミルフィー祝福しちゃうぞっ～
source:
Main character wakes up and sees two celestial girls from his dreams. Both girls want to pass angel exam. The exam condition is only one - to make one person happy.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/01/vn-of-month-september-2000.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主人公醒来时，看见梦中出现过的两名天界少女。两人都希望通过天使考试，而考试的条件只有一个——让一个人获得幸福。

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/01/vn-of-month-september-2000.html]vndbreview[/url]]
